text: Plugin, repo and marketplace are all named a2a-dispatch.
author: claude-code
rationale: Leading 'a2a' matches directory and GitHub searches for the protocol; claude-a2a and a2a-bridge are taken by several repos; 'driver' reads as a device driver.

evidence.ref: gh search + npm view + plugin-directory-cache on 2026-10-04: no exact match

cost_if_wrong: Renaming after release breaks /plugin install ids and every link.

text: Version 1 is an outbound A2A client only: Claude sends tasks, workers answer.
author: claude-code
rationale: User wants Claude as the driver; a mod cannot listen on a port, so inbound needs a separate server process and an auth story.
choice: Outbound tools plus a polling timer that wakes Claude through $.prompt.submit when a task finishes
alternatives: Sidecar A2A server so other agents can call into the live session

text: A mod's $.http.fetch resolves only after the whole body is read, so A2A SSE streaming (message/stream) is not reachable from a mod.
author: claude-code

evidence.ref: plugin-authoring types claude-code.d.ts HttpResponse/http.fetch doc, Claude Code 2.1.288

text: JSON-RPC calls to workers are written by hand in the mod; @a2a-js/sdk is a dev dependency only, used as the reference server in tests.
author: claude-code
rationale: The mod runtime has no Node and reaches the network only through $.http.fetch; the client surface needed is three methods.

author: claude-code
rationale: Matches the user's other TS repos (Personal site, engrammic app, tessera artifacts).

text: A mod hook has a 10 s budget of its own time; $.clock.sleep counts against it, $.http.fetch and other $ calls do not.
author: claude-code

evidence.ref: claude-code.d.ts HookBudget (ms: 10_000) and clock.sleep doc, Claude Code 2.1.288

revisit: When HookBudget changes in the types

text: send waits inline only within the hook budget (about 7.5 s of polling); slower tasks are tracked and wake Claude when done.
author: claude-code
rationale: A blocking fetch cannot be aborted or timed out from a mod, so a slow worker would hang the tool call; sleeps past 10 s kill the hook.
alternatives: Blocking send (returnImmediately=false) inside the tool call
A wait parameter up to 120 s
